FEES ACT 1951

FEES (MEDICAL) (FULL PAYING PATIENT) (AMENDMENT) ORDER 2014

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 3 of the Fees Act 1951 [Act 209],

the Yang di-Pertuan Agong makes the following order:

Citation

1. This order may be cited as the Fees (Medical) (Full Paying Patient)

(Amendment) Order 2014.

Amendment of First Schedule

2. The Fees (Medical) (Full Paying Patient) Order 2007 [P.U. (A) 252/2007] which is

referred to as the "principal Order" in this Order, is amended by substituting for the

First Schedule the following schedule:
